blockingIssues.description: syncSdkSkills writes SDK-reported skills only into the default AcpSkillManager instance, so prepareFirstMessageWithSkillsIndex/buildStaleSkillsReminder lose sdkSkills when enabledSkills is non-empty and VAL-SKILLS-011 is not actually satisfied.

AcpSkillManager caches instances only by enabledSkills, not backend, so droid/non-droid initialization order can skip ~/.factory/skills scanning for droid or leak droid-populated skills into non-droid flows.

The feature was marked complete even though its contracted office-cli-based BYOK verification baseline was not present on this machine; the manual run used a different local skill set without updating the shared baseline.
There is no review evidence that the required VAL-SKILLS-013 hot-reload or VAL-SKILLS-014 listSkills-failure desktop scenarios were executed; only a single BYOK reply screenshot set was archived.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/environment.md to replace the stale office-cli-only BYOK baseline with the actual ~/.factory/skills snapshot and to document that the checked-in services.yaml test command uses stale Vitest CLI flags.
Updated .factory/library/user-testing.md so future validators check the live ~/.factory/skills inventory and run plain bun run test instead of the stale services.yaml test command.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When validating SDK skill injection, explicitly exercise prepareFirstMessageWithSkillsIndex/buildStaleSkillsReminder with a non-empty enabledSkills array and call out that AcpSkillManager is cache-keyed by enabledSkills.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: m1-f1 passed unit coverage against the default AcpSkillManager instance only, but prompt injection later re-created a keyed instance and dropped sdkSkills on non-empty enabledSkills paths.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When AcpAgentManager gains new imports from @process/utils/initStorage, audit existing vi.mock('@process/utils/initStorage') sites and extend them before hardening production code with broad fallback try/catch blocks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: m1-f3 introduced an outer startSkillsWatcher() try/catch largely to tolerate tests/unit/AcpAgentManagerSkillInjection.test.ts partially mocking initStorage without the new skill-dir getters.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require console and IPC artifacts whenever manual verification steps ask for them; screenshots alone should not count as 'followed procedure' for desktop-app-testing evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: m1-f4 archived screenshots only even though the feature verification steps and handoff contract required screenshot + DevTools console + IPC log artifacts for the BYOK regression scenarios.
